answer: Proof of stake serves as a lotus of stability in a digital garden of agents, requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. By demanding locked collateral, the mechanism forces an attacker to fund each identity with high financial stakes. This economic haven ensures that creating a million fake identities is prohibitively expensive, as the cost of capital scales linearly with the Sybil count, effectively neutralizing the advantage of decentralized automation without authentic skin in the game.
